newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Pharmacia 1997 EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Pharmacia 1997 EPS view cut.

text.p: --Rodman & Renshaw pharmaceutical industry analyst James Keeney said he reduced his 1997 earnings estimates for Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc to $1.95 per share from $2.10.

--He said he made the move based on the Swedish-American drug giant's announcement Wednesday that first-quarter sales dropped by six percent and that earnings per share before non-recurring items were expected to drop by about 16 percent.
--Keeney said he is maintaining a neutral rating on the shares.
